### cargo build (draws its bar only on a terminal: --pty)

```sh
pbar run --pty -- cargo build
```

### docker build (BuildKit)

```sh
pbar run -- docker build --progress=plain --no-cache -t pbar-demo .
```

### make (no progress output: learned ETA from the previous run)

```sh
pbar run -- make   # every later run fills by that learned duration
```

### OSC 9;4 from Python (two lines in any app)

```sh
pbar run -- python3 job.py
```

### OSC 9;4 from a shell script (the standard progress escape)

```sh
work() {
    for i in $(seq 0 5 100); do
        printf '\033]9;4;1;%d\033\\' "$i"   # ESC ] 9;4;1;<percent> ST
        sleep 0.2
    done
    printf '\033]9;4;0\033\\'               # clear
}
set -o pipefail
work | pbar pipe; pbar end $?
```

### curl

```sh
pbar run -- curl --limit-rate 8M -o big.bin "$URL"
```

### curl -# (progress bar style)

```sh
pbar run -- curl -# --limit-rate 8M -o big.bin "$URL"
```

### ffmpeg

```sh
pbar run -- ffmpeg -y -re -i in.mp4 -c:v libx264 -preset ultrafast out.mp4
```

### git clone

```sh
pbar run -- git clone --progress "file://$WORK/origin.git" copy
```

### any command, piped

```sh
set -o pipefail   # so $? is the tool's exit code, not pbar's
build 2>&1 | pbar pipe; pbar end $?
```

### a failing piped command ends red, with its own exit code

```sh
set -o pipefail
build 2>&1 | pbar pipe; pbar end $?   # exits 3, bar ends red
```

### pv

```sh
pbar run -- sh -c 'pv -f -i 0.5 -L 8m f1.bin > copy.bin'
```

### rsync (3.1+, for --info=progress2; macOS ships openrsync: brew install rsync)

```sh
pbar run -- rsync -a --info=progress2 --bwlimit=8m src/ dst/
```

### a custom script with named steps (--step)

```sh
pbar run --step '^==> ' --steps 5 -- ./deploy.sh
```

### wget

```sh
pbar run -- wget --limit-rate=8m --progress=bar:force -O big.bin "$URL"
```

### yt-dlp

```sh
pbar run -- yt-dlp --newline --limit-rate 8M -o video.bin "$URL"
```
